title: eat shit & die 219
author: bpatrick
html: “Hey b., why did it take you four days to color this comic?” I honestly don’t know. I picked this comic to do because it was the shortest of the ones on deck. At any rate this made my whole week! An awesome display! Thank you! Now I wish I could draw better to be worthy of such a showing.
